sloka: यत्तु रामो विजानीयादभिज्ञानमनिन्दिते ।प्रीतिसञ्जननं तस्य प्रदातुं त्वमिहार्हसि ।। ५.६७.३० ।।।।
transliteration: yattu rāmo vijānīyādabhijñānamanindite ।prītisañjananaṁ tasya pradātuṁ tvamihārhasi ।। 5.67.30 ।।।।

translations.english: "loosed the excellent knot of her braid and gave me this gem, O you of great strength. Receiving the gem in both hands for your sake, beloved of the Raghus,
